issues.reason: Compound concepts exposes a modifier genus only for a modifier predicable of the referent ("the bridge is wooden") and never for a purpose / association modifier — "the law is anti-terror" fails that test — and (Inheritance anti_terror_law anti_terror) additionally says a law is a kind of anti-terror, which is false.

Truth values at a glance fixes epistemic Might / Probably / Must at confidence 0.9, and the hedged "could be executed" is carried by no atom of its own here, so the enclosing statement's 0.99 asserts more evidence than the text supplies (the empirical-conditional dial gives 0.9 as well).

The issue mistakes a coverage gap for a defect — it is the reviewer's own first gap: Before is unmeasured, BeforeBy needs a stated count, and the bare-plural "in the weeks" has no carrier, so leaving the unrepresentable interval out (rather than inventing a magnitude) is what the instruction set directs.

gaps_confirmed: vague measured gap between two eventualities ("in the weeks after X") — Before is unmeasured and BeforeBy needs a stated count, so a bare-plural interval has no carrier (there is no BeforeByAtLeast counterpart to MeasureAtLeast)

indicative conditional over a specific individual with an episodic antecedent ("If found guilty, he could be executed") — a plain Implication is prescribed but its premise here is built from freshly minted constants (sk_find_1, sk_guilty_1) that no later assertion can ever match, so the rule is permanently unfirable

declarative / verdictive secondary predicate ("found guilty") — the resultative rule is written for a state the action physically causes, and nothing says where a judicially conferred status falls between resultative and depictive
new_gaps: "anti-terror laws passed in the weeks after the bombings" is another episodic bare plural — the determiner rule sends every bare plural to the generic / kind reading, yet these are specific laws, and the group-witness reading the parse uses is uncovered
repair_summary: Dropped (Inheritance anti_terror_law anti_terror), the illicit purpose-modifier genus, keeping the head genus (Inheritance anti_terror_law law). Lowered the conditional's confidence from 0.99 to 0.9 so the epistemic Might in its consequent carries the confidence the dial assigns.
notes: The unanchored "he" as a person witness, the framing (Under ...) oblique, the agentless passives, the bare Before, and the absence of tense beside the bare epistemic modal are all correct and untouched.
